evals.name: corporate-wellness-app
evals.prompt: Analyze a corporate wellness app that rewards employees with gift cards for hitting fitness goals, shares team leaderboards with managers, and integrates with health insurance for premium discounts. Run the Motivation Matrix — map how Achievement, Social Acceptance, Fear, Power, and Incentive motivations interact with this product.
evals.expected_output: Matrix mapping each motivation type to specific product features, identifying where motivation is healthy vs. manipulative, with ethical threshold assessments.

evals.name: language-learning-streaks
evals.prompt: Apply the Motivation Matrix to Duolingo's core mechanics: streaks, XP points, leaderboards, heart system (limited mistakes), and friend challenges. For each motivation type, identify what the app activates and whether it's ethical motivation or manipulation.
evals.expected_output: Motivation matrix covering all five motivations with specific mechanics mapped to each, distinguishing intrinsic learning motivation from extrinsic pressure.

evals.name: employee-review-platform
evals.prompt: Our 360-degree employee review platform makes peer feedback visible to managers, ranks employees by 'helpfulness score,' and ties the score to promotion eligibility. Run the Motivation Matrix.
evals.expected_output: Matrix showing how each motivation type drives different behaviors (genuine helpfulness, performative feedback, fear-based compliance), with ethical audit of power dynamics.
